title: Accident-Scene Tows and Restored Service Calls, Cardinal Roadside Assistance
content:
Claims coordination note for Cardinal Roadside Assistance and Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage.

## Accident-scene tows

A tow from the scene of an accident is paid under the vehicle's physical damage claim where the Cardinal Roadside Assistance option provides that accident tows are paid under physical damage and the vehicle carries Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage. When such a tow was dispatched through roadside assistance, the call is restored and the tow cost moves to the claim. A vehicle without physical damage coverage uses a roadside call for an accident tow.

| Vehicle carries Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage | Tow dispatched through roadside assistance | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Tow paid under the physical damage claim; the roadside call is restored and the tow cost moves to the claim |
| No | Yes | The accident tow uses a roadside call |

## Other dispatches whose call is restored

A used call is also given back to the allowance for:

- a call cancelled within 20 minutes of the request and before a provider was dispatched;
- a duplicate dispatch;
- a provider who never arrived.

| Option | Minutes after the request within which a cancellation before dispatch restores the call |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | 20 |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | 20 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | 20 |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | 20 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | 20 |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | 20 |

The cancellation case needs both parts: the cancellation falls within the 20 minutes, and no provider had yet been dispatched.

| Hypothetical cancellation | Within 20 minutes of the request | Before a provider was dispatched | Call restored under the cancellation case |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cancelled 12 minutes after the request, no provider assigned yet | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Cancelled 12 minutes after the request, provider already dispatched | Yes | No | No |
| Cancelled 35 minutes after the request, no provider assigned yet | No | Yes | No |

## Once per dispatch

A dispatch is restored at most once, whatever the reason: a dispatch whose call has already been restored is not restored a second time.

## Hypothetical illustration

A member's car is towed from a collision through roadside assistance. The car carries Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage. The roadside call used for the tow is given back, and the tow cost is carried on the physical damage claim. Had the car carried no physical damage coverage, the tow would have stayed on the roadside allowance as a used call.
